name: Big Arm Unit - Flathead Lake State Park
evidence: ReserveAmerica per-site 'Proximity to Water: Shore' on RV sites A004-A016, B001-B016 (B017-B022, A001-A003 'Water View'); satellite at 47.8085,-114.3110: gravel pad spurs in open ponderosa ~25-50m from the high-water/pine edge of the pebble beach, no road or used strip between (drawdown beach not counted)

name: Greenough Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232771 flags sites 01-03,05,07,09,10 Riverfront, but satellite at 45.0555,-109.4138 with rec.gov site coords plotted: Rock Creek channel legible, those pads ~26-48m back behind a continuous conifer stand (buffer case); old pin was entrance bridge ~400m NE

name: Lolo Creek Campground
evidence: satellite at 46.7760,-114.3855 + USGS topo: campground loops are west across the bridge, ~55-70m from Lolo Creek through continuous forest; old pin was the highway-side entrance/picnic loop east of the creek; FS page has no per-site detail

name: Moose Creek Flat Campground
evidence: legible satellite at 45.3546,-111.1733 with rec.gov 233738 site coords: west-row RV pads 05-09 (RVs parked) ~15-25m from the Gallatin River edge across open meadow and only a thin, patchy bank fringe; 01-04 sit behind a denser conifer strip

name: Many Pines Campground
evidence: old pin was forest hillside east of US-89; satellite at 46.8992,-110.6909: loop and south spur west of US-89, small Belt Creek ~30-60m east behind meadow/forest and willows, no pad legibly at the bank; FS page gives no per-site map - default down

name: Lid Creek Campground
evidence: satellite at 48.2860,-113.9098 with rec.gov 234474 site coords: all pads ~55-75m inside continuous conifer forest from the Hungry Horse high-water (forest) edge, perimeter road on the north side; no per-site water flags on rec.gov; no overlook confirmed

name: Langohr Campground
evidence: satellite at 45.5348,-111.0160 with rec.gov 233745 site coords: RV sites 06 and 07 (40-45ft) sit ~10-15m from Hyalite Creek (~10m wide) across open meadow, no willow screen there; 05, 08 and 14-16 within ~20-30m; rec.gov amenity 'Waterfront Sites'

name: Lakeside Campground (Lake Alva)
evidence: rec.gov 233204 flags RV sites LSS4-LSS6 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' + 'Waterfront Sites'; rec.gov entrance is on the WEST side of Hwy 83 and site coords put them between highway and Lake Alva, ~25-45m from shore through open conifers (pads canopy-hidden); prior 'east of Hwy 83' was wrong
